profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with a bachelor's degree in Robotics, passionate about science, and technology. Driven by curiosity.

I’m also eager to meet other software engineers in the area, so feel free to connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed a new project for next-generation Sprayers, by going through the stages of the V-Model for software Development.
● Worked with C++/QT for the Frontend side, and C/MATLAB for the Embedded side.
● Achieved full testing of the project with Unit Testing, SIL, MIL, and HIL.

positions.title: Computer Vision Software Engineer - Intern
positions.description:
● Developed pedestrian navigation technology to make walking safe and accessible to everyone (blind, elderly, visually impaired).
● Implemented 3 main features of the device, e.g., A directions & route service using GPS and HERE Maps API;  Programmed an Alert from the device whenever the user is walking outside the sidewalk or an object is blocking the way; Created an Emergency Assistance that sends a text message whenever a fall is detected based with IMU information and an ML model. Using Python, Numpy, and Tensorflow as backend, hosted in an AWS server, connected through an API with Flask.
● Completed Data gathering/classification/tagging to an App Deployed with React Native and Expo.

positions.title: IT intern @TEC [Garage]
positions.description: Front End Web Developer. HTML5, CSS, Javascript, JQuery.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
● Collaborated in the Autonomous Driving LAB with a DL pipeline for generating better autonomous driving models.
● Created a method for obtaining  map information from aerial imagery, allowing to convert recording and identification of vehicles to a map with movement information, by using Python, numpy and OpenCV for the video translation to the map, and Keras with CNN’s (FCN 8s-32s, VGG16, U-NET) for the Semantic Segmentation of the roads.

positions.title: CO-OP, Design of Smart Devices using IoT
positions.description:
● Construction of a geolocator device.
● Achieved an error range of less than 4 meters, by using CMX Cisco Controller and Arduinos WIFI module ESP 12 -E.
